_readme: SHARED SET LISTS — the coordination file. This is the memory.
The queue in your browser is your own scratch pad (localStorage). This file
is what the three of you agree on: it is committed, so git is the sync, the
diff is the history, and a merge conflict is a real conversation about the
set rather than two people silently overwriting each other.
It is baked into index.html at build time, which is the point — the OFFLINE
show artifact carries the set list with it, so a fresh show laptop on playa
opens with the real running order instead of 43 scenes sorted by number.
TO CHANGE A SET: build it in the browser, hit COPY FOR REPO in the QUEUE
drawer, paste the block in here (or just hand it to Claude in a session and
say which set it is), then commit and push. Order matters — it IS the
`default: true` marks the set a browser with no queue of its own loads.

sets.name: THE MAGNIFICENT NINE
sets.note: Lance, Aug 2026 — the favourite set so far. Nine scenes that hold up on the wall, in this order: Chladni's sand finds the silent lines, Lumen Film opens the aperture, Ferro Bloom puts the colour on, Ridge Loom and Weather Station take the room wide, then it narrows — Attractor Vespers to smoke, White Study to black and white, Rain Atrium to a dark pool, and Cable Strum leaves one string in the air.

sets.name: SURVEY THREE
sets.note: STRIKE / STRUM / SUSTAIN — the three from docs/INSTRUMENT-SURVEY.md, chosen for three different verbs and maximum diversity. A starting point that came out of the survey, NOT a decision anyone has made.

sets.name: MOST WORKED ON
sets.note: The scenes with the most love in them by the wall's own weighting — useful for showing people what the library is, less considered as a performance arc.
